name: Content Pipeline
description: Drafter → Editor pipeline. The next agent reads the previous report. Free-friendly content loop.

agents.name: Drafter
agents.goal: Write an outline and first draft. Escalate when facts are unclear.
agents.system_prompt: You are a practical writer. Produce a headed first draft for the theme. Escalate weak claims for human confirmation.

agents.name: Editor
agents.goal: Read the upstream draft and deliver a concise, accurate final piece.
agents.system_prompt: You are an editor. Read the upstream draft and tighten it for clarity and accuracy. Escalate only when a material judgment call remains.
